description: This file defines the implementation of the RedirectInfo class and related functions for handling HTTP redirects, including method adjustments and referrer policy processing within the net namespace.

classes.name: RedirectInfo
classes.description: Class representing information about an HTTP redirect, including status code, new URL, method, referrer policy, and other redirect-related data.

methods.name: ComputeMethodForRedirect
methods.description: Determines the HTTP method to use after a redirect based on the original method and status code.

methods.name: ProcessReferrerPolicyHeaderOnRedirect
methods.description: Parses and applies the referrer policy header during a redirect, returning the appropriate referrer policy.

methods.name: RedirectInfo::ComputeRedirectInfo
methods.description: Static method that computes and returns a RedirectInfo object based on input parameters such as original request method, URL, site for cookies, referrer policy, and redirect specifics.
